note.zh-TW: 間接法照教材從稅前淨利起算。
note.en: The indirect method starts from this line, as the course does.

definition.zh-TW: 扣所得稅之前的獲利，是五層利益的第四層。它也是間接法現金流量表的起算點，所以損益表與現金流量表的這個數字必須相同（勾稽點 A）。
definition.en: Profit before income tax is deducted, the fourth of the five profit levels. It is also the starting point of the indirect-method cash flow statement, so the figure must agree between the two statements (check A).
